meta.description: DOE National Laboratory targets for BioMate beta outreach
meta.focus: DOE BER (Biological and Environmental Research) — metagenomics, environmental genomics, bioenergy synthetic biology

targets.name: DOE Joint Genome Institute (JGI)
targets.reach_channel: paper-citation, DOE BER program officers, conference (ISME)
targets.notes: World's largest public genomics facility. Processes tens of thousands of metagenomics samples/year for DOE BER. BioMate's QC governance + metagenomics workflows are directly complementary. Strategic partnership or co-publication opportunity.

targets.name: Oak Ridge National Laboratory — Biosciences Division
targets.notes: Major DOE BER-funded biosciences research. Switchgrass + poplar bioenergy crop genomics. Metagenomics for carbon capture via soil microbiome.

targets.name: Pacific Northwest National Laboratory — Biological Sciences Division
targets.notes: EMSL (Environmental Molecular Sciences Lab) — one of the most powerful multiomics facilities in the world. Mass spec proteomics + metagenomics. BioMate proteomics QC is directly relevant.

targets.name: Lawrence Livermore National Laboratory — Biosciences & Biotechnology Division
targets.notes: Focus includes biosecurity genomics and environmental metagenomics. NanoSIMS isotope-tracing methods for microbial activity characterization.

targets.name: Argonne National Laboratory — Biosciences Division
targets.notes: Home of MG-RAST (one of the most-used metagenomics analysis platforms globally). Folker Meyer's team processes millions of samples. BioMate's QC governance layer could complement MG-RAST.

targets.name: Lawrence Berkeley National Laboratory — Environmental Genomics & Systems Biology
targets.notes: Adam Arkin is one of the most prominent systems biologists. KBase bioinformatics platform originates here — BioMate could position as a researcher-facing complement.

targets.name: National Renewable Energy Laboratory (NREL) — Biosciences Center
targets.reach_channel: DOE BER networking, algae biofuels conferences
targets.notes: DOE's primary renewable energy lab. Major algae biofuels and cellulosic biomass program. BioMate's metagenomics + metabolic engineering workflows directly relevant.

targets.name: Sandia National Laboratories — Systems Biology Group
targets.notes: Biosecurity + national security genomics applications. Growing synthetic biology program.

targets.name: Los Alamos National Laboratory — Biosecurity & Public Health Division
targets.notes: Pathogen surveillance + biosecurity genomics. Metagenomics QC workflows relevant.
